label: <actor> act<NN> stg<1-3>
attack_ids: 1..59: the fighter's own ROM attack ID (0x0C3E me / 0x0E3E him), per character

reserved.act72: walking away from the other fighter

specials_without_box: act80..act99: act80 + SPECIAL_CLASS (0x0C49 / 0x0E49), a special put out no box
unknown_dropped: an attack cut before any ID or class (cut)
an impossible x on a standing row
stage: stg = 1 + 3 * (t - start) // length of the fighter's episode (thirds: start / middle / end)
episode: a run of state 0x0A / 0x0C / 0x04 (one code, the run's first non-zero attack ID; a jump with an attack is labelled with the attack, not split), else a run of rows with one code
